question: Should Firefox Release, Beta, Developer Edition, and Nightly become distinct public Browser cases backed by install-aware profile attribution, or remain represented by one unified Firefox source?
rationale: The existing folder-based catalog cannot by itself establish which Firefox installation owns a profile, while separate cases affect public API, default ordering, labeling, and duplicate handling.

options.title: Install-Aware Channel Cases
options.body: Parse and correlate Firefox profile and installation metadata, exposing distinct channel stores only when attribution is reliable and deduplicated.

options.title: Unified Firefox Source
options.body: Keep Browser.firefox and improve store labeling or documentation without claiming release-channel identity.

options.title: Shared-Root Aliases
options.body: Add separate cases that scan the same profile root and accept ambiguous or duplicated stores.

recommendation.title: Install-Aware Channel Cases
recommendation.body: Parse and correlate Firefox profile and installation metadata, exposing distinct channel stores only when attribution is reliable and deduplicated.
